bundle.longDescription: Orca RS is a lightweight desktop build of Orca. It bundles the Orca runtime (orcad) and a Node runtime, starts the runtime locally on loopback, and shows the Orca client in a system-webview window. Projects, terminals and agents run on this machine; remote Orca servers can still be paired.
bundle.shortDescription: Orca RS - local Orca desktop, Tauri shell
